issue.title: test_auto_refresh_task_keeps_loop_live_and_coalesces_ticks flakes in the full check lane
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/ace/tui/test_event_handlers_auto_refresh_clean_ticks.py::test_auto_refresh_task_keeps_loop_live_and_coalesces_ticks`
- **Repro:** `sase tool run check` (the check run escalated to the full parallel pytest lane); rerun the exact node on the unchanged tree to distinguish a deterministic regression.

During unrelated Claude OAuth refresh-lock retry verification on 2026-09-25, `just check` escalated to the 14-worker full pytest lane and failed this exact node. The unchanged-tree focused rerun passed, establishing an intermittent full-lane/pass-on-rerun failure. The assigned implementation changes Claude OAuth refresh locking and does not touch ACE auto-refresh event handling. Fail rate observed: 1 failure in 1 full-lane observation, followed by 1 passing exact-node rerun; serial behavior beyond that rerun is unconfirmed.

task_type_fields.evidence: Full 14-worker check lane failed once; exact unchanged-tree rerun passed once. The unrelated OAuth refresh-lock implementation does not touch ACE auto-refresh handlers. Serial behavior is not yet established.

payload.description: Need to confirm the observed auto-refresh test flake was recorded with evidence before finalizing the separate Claude OAuth retry implementation.

payload.entry: Dormant-flake close (epic sase-1oh landing, decision dormant_flakes=close; sase-1oh.land follow-up, 2026-10-27).
